name: lantern-ui-dev
description: Build + test harness for priv/static/lantern_ui_hooks.js. NOT published to npm and NOT part of the Hex package (see the `files:` whitelist in mix.exs). Consumers import the committed bundle — they do not need a JS toolchain. Layout: lantern_ui_hooks.js + chunks/ + zag/select.js is the split on-demand build (shared floating-ui lives in chunks/); lantern_ui_hooks.standalone.js is the single-file fallback with everything inlined.

scripts.build: rm -rf priv/static/chunks priv/static/zag && esbuild assets/js/lantern_ui_hooks.js assets/js/zag/select.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --splitting --outdir=priv/static --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] && esbuild assets/js/lantern_ui_hooks.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=priv/static/lantern_ui_hooks.standalone.js
